title: Goldman Sachs’ blunt words for Amazon stock investors after big deal

title: US Equity Indexes Rise This Week as Hormuz Chokepoint Reopening Fuels Iran Deal Hopes
title_zh: 霍尔木兹咽喉要道的重新开放激发了伊朗协议的希望，美国股指本周上涨

title: Bitcoin Climbs to Two-Month High Amid Middle East Deal Optimism
title_zh: 在中东交易乐观情绪中比特币攀升至两个月高点
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Bitcoin rose to the highest level since early February after a flurry of comments from the US and Iran sparked optimism that the conflict in the Middle East may be heading toward a resolution.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国和伊朗的一系列言论引发了人们对中东冲突可能走向解决的乐观情绪，比特币升至 2 月初以来的最高水平。
